title: Check From the Edge
setup: Black's king on f6 has its queen sitting two squares away on d6, on the very same rank.
hint: The black king and queen share a rank. Where can your queen enter that rank with check and stay safe?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qh6+}} slides onto the sixth rank with check, and the black queen on **d6** is stuck behind its own king. The pawn on g5 cannot reach h6, so the check stands. {{Kf7}} is the only legal step, and {{Qxd6}} takes the queen.
